lines.zh: 我沿着洞穴岩壁走，脚步像你的脚步。
lines.en: I walk along the cave wall, my steps sounding like yours.

lines.zh: 夜里我从阴影里迈出来，慢得像散步。
lines.en: At night I step out of the shade, slow as a stroll.

lines.zh: 我已经开始跟踪，你听见的呼吸是我的。
lines.en: I have started stalking; the breathing you hear is mine.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在你刚踩过的位置。
lines.en: Every step I take lands where yours just landed.

lines.zh: 我绕过火把，避开光，只走在暗处。
lines.en: I go around the torches, staying in the dark.

lines.zh: 木板门挡不住我，我正朝它走过去。
lines.en: A wooden door will not hold me; I am walking to it.

lines.zh: 我的脚没有留下脚印，只有声音。
lines.en: My feet leave no prints, only sound behind.

lines.zh: 我隔着一片树叶跟着你，速度刚好。
lines.en: I follow you behind the leaves, keeping your pace.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像早知道你要去哪。
lines.en: I walk steadily, as if I already know your road.

lines.zh: 洞穴的水洼照出我，和你长得一样。
lines.en: The cave puddle mirrors me, shaped just like you.

lines.zh: 我在你身后三步，一直保持三步。
lines.en: I stay three steps behind you, always three.

lines.zh: 我不跑，我只走，可你甩不掉我。
lines.en: I never run, only walk, and you cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，脸照着你的样子捏成。
lines.en: I stand still, my face shaped to match yours.

lines.zh: 我数你的心跳，一下，又一下。
lines.en: I count your heartbeats, one, and then another.

lines.zh: 洞穴滴水，我等水声停下来再动。
lines.en: The cave drips; I wait for the drip to stop.

lines.zh: 我微微偏头，在听你呼吸的间隙。
lines.en: I tilt my head, listening between your breaths.

lines.zh: 我离你四十格以内就不急了。
lines.en: Within forty blocks of you, I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我在门边停住，把手指搭在木板上。
lines.en: I stop by the door and rest a finger on the wood.

lines.zh: 我没有表情，可我在看你。
lines.en: I have no expression, but I am watching you.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃，也不需要睡，只等天黑。
lines.en: I do not eat or sleep; I only wait for night.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我先动，落向你脚边。
lines.en: My shadow moves before me, falling at your feet.

lines.zh: 我听见你关门的声音，记下了。
lines.en: I hear your door close, and I remember it.

lines.zh: 我站在矿洞拐角，把自己折进黑暗。
lines.en: I stand at the mine's corner, folding into the dark.

lines.zh: 有你在，这片林子就安静得奇怪。
lines.en: With you here, this forest goes strangely quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等你灭掉最后一支火把。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to put out the last torch.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，眨眼会让你觉得我好对付。
lines.en: I never blink; blinking would make me seem easy.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，只跟着你的节奏起伏。
lines.en: I don't breathe; I just rise and fall with your rhythm.

lines.zh: 你屋里的灯一灭，我就开始数秒。
lines.en: When your lamp goes out, I start counting seconds.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，用和你一样的眼睛。
lines.en: I look up at you with eyes just like yours.

lines.zh: 你转头，我正好也在看你。
lines.en: You turn your head, and I am already looking.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脸，学你的表情。
lines.en: I stare at your face and copy its expression.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我知道，我不躲。
lines.en: You are looking at me; I know, and I do not hide.

lines.zh: 我第一次被你看见，就不必潜行了。
lines.en: Now that you have seen me, I need not sneak.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔跟着你的火光收缩。
lines.en: My pupils narrow with the flicker of your torch.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，好像听不懂你在说什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if I cannot understand you.

lines.zh: 你看我太久，我就会以为你留下了。
lines.en: If you look too long, I will think you are staying.

lines.zh: 我们的视线撞上，是你先移开的。
lines.en: Our eyes meet, and you are the one who looks away.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看到一个 Steve 的形状。
lines.en: In your eyes I see the shape of a Steve.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，动作和你抬手一样慢。
lines.en: I raise my hand as slowly as you raise yours.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我就停住，让你看清。
lines.en: When you look, I stop so you can see me clearly.

lines.zh: 我记得住你的脸，记得很牢。
lines.en: I will remember your face, and remember it well.

lines.zh: 我朝你点头，像老朋友那样。
lines.en: I nod at you, the way an old friend would.

lines.zh: 你看我一眼，我就记住你的眼神。
lines.en: One glance from you and I have your look memorized.

lines.zh: 我侧过脸，好让你看清轮廓。
lines.en: I turn my face so you can see the shape of it.

lines.zh: 你数我的手，我数你的脉搏。
lines.en: You count my fingers; I count your pulse.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的后颈，那里最薄。
lines.en: I stare at the back of your neck. Thinnest spot.

lines.zh: 第二次回头，你才认出是我。
lines.en: On the second look back, you finally know it's me.

lines.zh: 我学你眨了一下眼，很慢。
lines.en: I copy your blink, slowly.

lines.zh: 你砍我，我掉了血，还要再砍很多次。
lines.en: You cut me; I lose health, and you must cut many times.

lines.zh: 四十点血，你算算还要多久。
lines.en: Forty health; work out how long that takes.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不流血，只渗出黑色的东西。
lines.en: My wound does not bleed; something black seeps out.

lines.zh: 我被打退，然后照原样走回来。
lines.en: I am knocked back, then walk back the way I was.

lines.zh: 你打我时，我的脸没有变。
lines.en: My face does not change while you hit me.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起自己本来不是这样。
lines.en: Pain reminds me I was not always like this.

lines.zh: 这一箭插在我肩上，我拔了出来。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder; I pull it out.

lines.zh: 你越打我，越像在打我自己的脸。
lines.en: The more you strike, the more you strike your own face.

lines.zh: 血条掉了一格，我还在往前走。
lines.en: A bar drops, and I keep walking forward.

lines.zh: 我不会求饶，我连话都不太会说。
lines.en: I will not beg; I barely speak at all.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我不饿，我只跟着。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I am not hungry, only following.

lines.zh: 食物对我没用，我的胃是空的。
lines.en: Food does nothing for me; my stomach is hollow.

lines.zh: 你把骨头丢过来，我看了很久。
lines.en: You toss a bone my way, and I stare at it.

lines.zh: 我不吃，可我喜欢你把东西递过来。
lines.en: I do not eat, but I like that you offer something.

lines.zh: 你挥手引我，我本来就在朝你走。
lines.en: You wave me over; I was already walking to you.

lines.zh: 那点香味穿过洞穴，我不为它转头。
lines.en: That smell crosses the cave; I do not turn for it.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西晃来晃去，很像我。
lines.en: The thing in your hand sways, looking much like me.

lines.zh: 我不靠近食物，我只靠近拿食物的人。
lines.en: I approach no food, only the one holding it.

lines.zh: 你把诱饵放在地上，我绕了过去。
lines.en: You set the bait down, and I walk around it.

lines.zh: 我检查了你的手，确认没有武器。
lines.en: I checked your hands, confirming there is no weapon.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的身体比看起来硬。
lines.en: You bump into me; my body is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我们擦肩，我停了半秒才继续走。
lines.en: We brush past; I pause half a second, then go on.

lines.zh: 你推我，我退了一步，又贴回来。
lines.en: You shove me; I step back and press in again.

lines.zh: 我挡在门口，没打算让路。
lines.en: I block the doorway, with no plan to move.

lines.zh: 你从我身边挤过去，我侧过头。
lines.en: You squeeze past me, and I turn my head.

lines.zh: 碰到你时，我的皮肤是凉的。
lines.en: When I touch you, my skin is cold.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你听见很轻的一声。
lines.en: We collide, and you hear a very soft sound.

lines.zh: 我没有躲，是你先撞上来的。
lines.en: I did not dodge; you are the one who hit me.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的头跟着转了一点。
lines.en: When you back away, my head turns a little.

lines.zh: 我站在路中间，等你决定绕不绕。
lines.en: I stand in the road, waiting to see if you detour.

lines.zh: 配对是活物的事，我已经不是了。
lines.en: Mating belongs to the living; I am not one.

lines.zh: 我这张脸是从别人身上借来的。
lines.en: This face of mine is borrowed from someone else.

lines.zh: 我不会留下后代，只会留下痕迹。
lines.en: I leave no offspring, only traces behind.

lines.zh: 两头像我这样的东西不会相遇。
lines.en: Two things like me never meet each other.

lines.zh: 你喂再多东西，也换不来幼崽。
lines.en: Feed me all you like; no young will come of it.

lines.zh: 我只会复制你的样子，不复制生命。
lines.en: I only copy your shape, never your life.

lines.zh: 这种东西不该有第二次出生。
lines.en: A thing like this should not be born twice.

lines.zh: 我的存在只是回声，回声不会生。
lines.en: I am only an echo, and echoes do not breed.

lines.zh: 你身边的动物会躲开我，它们懂。
lines.en: The animals near you avoid me; they understand.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴侣，我需要你回头。
lines.en: I need no mate; I need you to turn around.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的箭，放进了口袋。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped arrow and pocket it.

lines.zh: 那块面包我收下了，虽然不吃。
lines.en: I take the bread, though I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 我把你的火把捡起来，火灭了。
lines.en: I pick up your torch, and the flame dies.

lines.zh: 你丢下的东西我都会拾走。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I will collect it.

lines.zh: 我蹲下捡起铁粒，动作很慢。
lines.en: I crouch for the iron nugget, moving slowly.

lines.zh: 我捡东西时一直看着你。
lines.en: I keep watching you the whole time I pick it up.

lines.zh: 你掉的刀我不还，我拿在手里。
lines.en: I keep the blade you dropped, holding it up.

lines.zh: 我捡起木板，把它靠在你的门边。
lines.en: I pick up planks and lean them by your door.

lines.zh: 你丢的骨头我收进箱子，摆好了。
lines.en: I put your dropped bone in a chest, arranged neatly.

lines.zh: 我把船拖到岸边，等你上来。
lines.en: I drag a boat to shore and wait for you.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，就从这棵树后面。
lines.en: I have you targeted, right from behind this tree.

lines.zh: 你点亮火把的那刻，我决定跟了。
lines.en: The moment you lit that torch, I decided to follow.

lines.zh: 我看见你的背影，就再也放不下。
lines.en: I saw your back, and could not let it go.

lines.zh: 目标确认，四十点血够我追很久。
lines.en: Target confirmed; forty health is enough to chase long.

lines.zh: 你走出村庄，正好走进我的范围。
lines.en: You leave the village and step into my range.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，只挑你。
lines.en: I am not picky about food, only about you.

lines.zh: 你回头那一下，把我引了过来。
lines.en: That glance back of yours pulled me in.

lines.zh: 我开始追，速度不快，但不会断。
lines.en: I begin the chase, slow but never breaking.

lines.zh: 洞穴里回声多，你的脚步更好认。
lines.en: Caves echo, so your steps are easier to pick out.

lines.zh: 你带着伤跑，这让我更想追。
lines.en: You run wounded, and that makes me want it more.

lines.zh: 我把你记成唯一目标，别的都放掉。
lines.en: I mark you as my only target and drop the rest.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋子，我记住了那扇门。
lines.en: You hide indoors; I memorized that door.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸变快了，因为近了。
lines.en: My breathing quickens because I am close.

lines.zh: 你终于看见我了，现在跑吧。
lines.en: You finally see me; now you should run.

lines.zh: 你熄了灯，我这才算找到你。
lines.en: Once you put out the light, I've really found you.

lines.zh: 脚步声一停，我就知道是你。
lines.en: The footsteps stop, and I know it's you.

lines.zh: 我一步不停地跟着，距离没有变。
lines.en: I follow without pause, and the distance never changes.

lines.zh: 你跑多快，我就跟多快，刚好差一点。
lines.en: However fast you run, I keep just short of you.

lines.zh: 你停，我也停；你走，我就走。
lines.en: You stop and I stop; you walk and I walk.

lines.zh: 木板门开始响，我在外面。
lines.en: The wooden door begins to creak; I am outside it.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，避开你插的火把。
lines.en: I hug the wall, avoiding the torches you placed.

lines.zh: 你在夜里跑，夜里是我最舒服的时候。
lines.en: You run at night, and night suits me best.

lines.zh: 我追得很稳，你迟早要喘。
lines.en: I chase steadily; sooner or later you must gasp.

lines.zh: 你翻过栅栏，我直接走门。
lines.en: You vault the fence; I simply use the door.

lines.zh: 你的脚印乱，说明你开始慌了。
lines.en: Your prints are scattered, which means you are panicking.

lines.zh: 我一直在你侧后方，不让你看清。
lines.en: I stay off your shoulder so you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 你喊也没用，这片林子只有我们。
lines.en: Shouting will not help; this forest holds only us.

lines.zh: 你越跑越快，我就越不肯停。
lines.en: The faster you run, the less I am willing to stop.

lines.zh: 我绕过水池，水面照出我们两个。
lines.en: I skirt the pond, and it shows both of us.

lines.zh: 你回头张望，正好对上我的脸。
lines.en: You glance back and meet my face exactly.

lines.zh: 你上坡，我就走坡下的暗处。
lines.en: You climb the slope; I keep to the dark beneath it.

lines.zh: 你关门的声音，我在外面数着。
lines.en: I count every door you close from outside.

lines.zh: 这片矿洞只有一个出口，我清楚。
lines.en: This cave has one way out, and I know it.

lines.zh: 你回头三次，我躲了三次。
lines.en: Three times you look back. Three times I hide.

lines.zh: 我不进你的光圈，只在边上等。
lines.en: I stay outside your torchlight and wait at its edge.

lines.zh: 你停下喘气，我就停在半步外。
lines.en: When you stop to breathe, I stop half a step away.

lines.zh: 我抬手打你，力气是四点的伤害。
lines.en: I swing at you; the blow lands for four.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可我不会只打一下。
lines.en: This hit is light, but I will not hit only once.

lines.zh: 我的指节撞在你肋骨上，很凉。
lines.en: My knuckles strike your ribs, and they are cold.

lines.zh: 你被击中退开，我跟着上前一步。
lines.en: The hit knocks you back; I take a step forward.

lines.zh: 我抓你的肩，指甲刮过皮革。
lines.en: I grab your shoulder, nails scraping the leather.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我就等你放下再打。
lines.en: You raise your shield; I wait for it to drop.

lines.zh: 我打你的时候没有喊，只有呼吸。
lines.en: I make no cry when I strike, only breath.

lines.zh: 这一拳是我学你的，打得还行。
lines.en: This punch is copied from you, and it works.

lines.zh: 你流血的声响，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: The sound of your bleeding is very clear to me.

lines.zh: 我专打你拿剑的那只手。
lines.en: I aim for the hand that holds your sword.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就不再急了。
lines.en: You back into the corner, and I stop hurrying.

lines.zh: 我撞开你的门，也撞开你的架势。
lines.en: I break your door, and break your stance with it.

lines.zh: 你砍中我，我照样把爪子送过去。
lines.en: You cut me, and I still push my claws through.

lines.zh: 我打得不快，但你挡不住第二下。
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot block the second.

lines.zh: 我的手扣住你的喉咙，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: My hand closes on your throat and tightens slowly.

lines.zh: 你倒地了，我蹲下来看你的脸。
lines.en: You're down. I crouch to look at your face.

lines.zh: 我从夜里长出来，脸先成形。
lines.en: I grow out of the night, my face forming first.

lines.zh: 这个洞穴太深，我就在这儿出现。
lines.en: This cave is deep enough, so I appear here.

lines.zh: 火把照不到的地方，我站起来。
lines.en: Where the torchlight fails, I stand up.

lines.zh: 我借着你的影子，学会了走路。
lines.en: I learned to walk from borrowing your shadow.

lines.zh: 石头缝里挤出一个 Steve 的轮廓。
lines.en: A Steve-shaped outline squeezes out of the stone.

lines.zh: 我第一次出现时，还不懂得躲。
lines.en: The first time I appeared, I did not know to hide.

lines.zh: 夜里生成的东西，都带着一点湿气。
lines.en: Things born at night carry a little damp.

lines.zh: 我从不远的地方来，走了很久。
lines.en: I come from not far away, and I walked a long time.

lines.zh: 这里黑得刚好，我就留下来了。
lines.en: It is just dark enough here, so I stayed.

lines.zh: 你点的那盏灯，把我引了出来。
lines.en: The lamp you lit drew me out.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声先到，人后到。
lines.en: My footsteps arrive first, and the rest of me after.

lines.zh: 重生点旁边也会长出我这样的东西。
lines.en: Things like me also grow beside a respawn point.

lines.zh: 世界多了一个我，少了一个你。
lines.en: The world gained one of me, and lost one of you.

lines.zh: 我在矿洞尽头等你，已经等很久。
lines.en: I wait at the mine's end, and I have waited long.

lines.zh: 你第一晚睡着时，我站在屋外。
lines.en: On your first night asleep, I'm standing outside.

lines.zh: 我顺着你来的路，一直退到洞口。
lines.en: I follow the way you came, back to the cave mouth.

lines.zh: 这一带火把全灭了，我正好出现。
lines.en: Every torch here has gone out, so I come through.

lines.zh: 我从你背后的墙里走出来，没有声音。
lines.en: I step out of the wall behind you without a sound.

lines.zh: 你在矿洞点灯，我才有了位置。
lines.en: You lit a lamp in the mine, and gave me a place to stand.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我从你看不见的那侧站起。
lines.en: Dark falls, and I rise on the side you can't see.

lines.zh: 火把我的皮肤烧得翻起来，像纸。
lines.en: Fire curls my skin up like paper.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，落地时没有声音。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的嘴，我还在朝你走。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I keep walking to you.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我爬起来继续跟。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; I get up and keep following.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我胸口，我低头看了看。
lines.en: An arrow pins my chest; I look down at it.

lines.zh: 魔法的光扫过我，我的形状晃了一下。
lines.en: Magic light sweeps me and my shape wavers.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，饿只是身体在变淡。
lines.en: I do not eat; hunger is only my body fading.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的轮廓亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my outline flashes bright.

lines.zh: 虚空把我吞下去，我还在看着你。
lines.en: The void swallows me and I am still watching you.
